extraction_supporting_text.cases: Sociodemographic and baseline health characteristics and nutrient intake levels of 1142 cases and 1154 controls in the eligible study population are presented by race in Table 1 . Compared to controls, cases were more likely to report a lower education level, smoke, have a higher BMI and family history of RCC, and diagnosed with hypertension.
